spellbook.finance/limitations: Workspace membership and account ownership are checked by SpellBook Finance. No credentials or provider account ids are accepted.
At most 100 named listings are resolved per call. Unknown or stale identities are named in the response and are not mapped to a guessed listing.

selectedListingKeyCount counts explicit selected TCGplayer and ManaPool policy memberships only. The all-mode listing-key total is unavailable; it is named in missingFields when an all-mode account is present.
The nominal 10,000-unit allowance is informational and soft. All copies of a listing stay together.

description: Read the connected TCGplayer or ManaPool account's saved listing scope, server-reported legacy full-account restore eligibility, managed-copy count, and selected-policy membership-key count. The selected key count does not total legacy all-mode remote listings. Supply candidateIds only from SpellBook Finance's existing named listing rows or holdings. Results report saved facts and unresolved identities; they do not choose which rows to manage. New accounts start with no managed listings. A backfilled legacy account may restore full-account management after switching to named listings.

candidateIds.description: At most 100 candidate IDs from existing SpellBook listing rows. Omit to read account scope and counts only.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

workspaceId.description: The seller workspace to read. Required.

name: spellbook_inventory_management_get
